name: Prayer of Healing
summary: Gives up to five creatures the benefits of a Short Rest and restores Hit Points to them.

stats.effect: Up to five creatures of your choice who remain within range for the spell's entire casting gain the benefits of a {ref:glossary/short-rest} and also regain 2d8 {ref:glossary/hit-points}. A creature can't be affected by this spell again until that creature finishes a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
stats.higherLevels: The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.
